metrics.name: text_type
metrics.rationale: Text values must be valid string data.

metrics.name: text_completeness
metrics.rationale: Empty strings or whitespace-only texts are prohibited.

metrics.name: encoding_cleanliness
metrics.rationale: Non-printable control characters and Unicode replacement chars are flagged.

metrics.name: normalized_uniqueness
metrics.rationale: Preserves natural repetition while checking uniqueness.

metrics.name: length_validity
metrics.rationale: Enforces minimum 5 characters and maximum 2000 characters.

metrics.name: label_completeness
metrics.rationale: Labels must be present for supervised training.

metrics.name: label_consistency
metrics.rationale: Identical normalized queries must not map to conflicting labels.

metrics.name: label_validity
metrics.rationale: Labels must belong to the approved intent vocabulary.

metrics.name: split_completeness
metrics.rationale: Each row must be assigned to train or test.

metrics.name: split_disjointness
metrics.rationale: Training queries must not leak into evaluation splits.

metrics.name: class_support
metrics.rationale: Each intent must have at least 20 training examples.

rationale: Reference benchmark policy evaluating 11 core text quality dimensions.
